why: Closes slot 1's arc into a full ring. Tempting, and wrong twice over: a solid ring is indistinguishable from the SHIPPED default, so the one slot a player is most likely to be would give them no marker at all; and 'the unbroken one is player 1' is a rule that has to be explained rather than seen, which is the failure the whole issue is about. Slots 2-4 are untouched, so every count assertion still passes -- caught only by the leaves-a-gap-even-at-one case, which measures the angular span of the single run.
